title: A Safehouse for the Deadline
author: Coral Kavanagh
blurb: August Galloway, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
